claim: The Euganean thermal water springs at 87°C, is classified as hyperthermal salso-bromo-iodic, and is unique in the world.
quote: The meteoric waters spring forth at a constant temperature of 87°C and are unique in the world... classified, from a chemical point of view, as hyperthermal, sodium-chloride, and... as salso-bromo-iodic with a fixed residue at 180° of 5-6 grams of dissolved salts per liter.

claim: Abano/Montegrotto fango is matured 60+ days in thermal water and contains the patented Phormidium ETS05 cyanobacterium responsible for its anti-inflammatory effect.
quote: The Euganean thermal clay contains a particular type of microalgae, the cyanobacteria Phormidium SP ETS05, which is deposited at the Institut Pasteur in Paris and is protected by a European patent.

claim: Y-40 The Deep Joy in Montegrotto lets non-divers walk a submerged transparent tunnel at -5 m and watch from the bar-bistro windows for free; divers must pre-register online with a QR code.
quote: watch the dives for free from the windows of the bar-bistro and from the underwater tunnel at -5 meters depth... All participants must register online, complete health disclosures, and generate QR codes before arrival.

claim: Y-40 holds 4.3 million litres of salso-bromo-iodic thermal water kept at 32–34°C with a maximum depth of 42.15 m — the deepest thermal pool in the world.
quote: Y-40 The Deep Joy has a surface area of 21x18m, a maximum depth of 42.15 meters... The pool holds 4,300,000 liters of salsobromoiodic thermal water, maintained at a temperature of 32-34°C.

claim: Hotel Mioni Pezzato in Abano sells a pool-only Spa Day from €75 (Mon-Thu) and massage-included packages at €120–155, open 8 am–9 pm, reservation mandatory.
quote: Spa Day 1: €75 (Mon-Thu) - Pool & spa access only... Access to and stay in the structure are allowed from 8 a.m. until 9 p.m... Spa Day tickets are available by reservation only and subject to availability.

claim: Day-pass prices across the basin range from €13–15 at Hotel Smeraldo/Milano (Abano) up to €40–45 at Hotel Mioni Royal San (Montegrotto), with €6–7 municipal pools also available.
quote: Hotel Smeraldo (3-star) Daily: €15 (Mon-Fri), €18 (Sat-Sun)... Hotel Mioni Royal San (4-star) Daily: €40 (Mon-Thu), €45 (Fri-Sun)... Piscine Comunali Daily: €6-€7.

claim: Terme Preistoriche in Montegrotto runs an adults-only Day Spa from October to March, online-booking only, with bathrobe and towel kit included.
quote: From 1 October to 31 March access to the Day Spa is reserved for guests over 16 years of age... The SPA KIT, which includes a bathrobe and towel, is included with every type of entry... Access to the facility is by reservation only.

claim: Hotel Savoia Thermae in Abano offers a Saturday day pass at €65 (€55 weekday) and an afternoon-only 14:00–22:00 entry from €35.
quote: Mon-Fri €55.00, Sat-Sun €65.00, Public holidays €85.00 for full wellness without overnight stay... Afternoon relaxation (2:00 PM to 10:00 PM) starting from €35.

claim: Visitors describe Abano as the livelier town with more shops, bars and hotels, while Montegrotto is a quieter walkable village next to the rail station and Roman archaeological area.
quote: Abano: more lively village, lots of shops, bars, more hotels on offer... Montegrotto: smaller village, railway station at a walkable distance, original roman SPAs location... not much to see do around (it's a sleepy village).

claim: The thermal water makes a 25-year underground journey from the Dolomites before surfacing at 87°C, and the Euganean fango is the regional curative speciality.
quote: The thermal water travels from the Lower Dolomites through a 25-year underground journey, soaking up mineral salts before gushing out at a temperature of 87°C... The mud here is so valued that the European Patent Office has declared it a drug.

claim: Fango is applied to the skin at 37–42°C for around 15 minutes and was clinically shown by the Centro Studi Termali Pietro D'Abano to match NSAIDs for anti-inflammatory effect without GI side-effects.
quote: The mud is applied directly to the skin and left for about 15 minutes at a temperature ranging between 37 °C and 42 °C... the mature fango therapy of Abano and Montegrotto Terme is as effective against inflammation as NSAID-based drug therapy, but without side effects on the gastrointestinal tract.
